description: Your key's usage today against its daily limits: jobs_today / job_limit, spend_today_usd / spend_limit_usd (live keys), and resets_at (midnight America/New_York). Check it before hiring to avoid a 429. Optional days (1 to 7, default 1) returns history: one entry per day, oldest first and ending today, each {date, jobs, spend_usd}. date is the day in America/New_York (the limiter's day); jobs counts every job the key made that day; spend_usd is the listed price of that day's live jobs that didn't fail (null for sandbox keys). Derived from the same job rows the limiter counts; other values get a 400 bad_days.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

days.description: How many days of history, ending today (1 to 7).
